lifecycle: Auto-initialises on DOMContentLoaded. A MutationObserver initialises markup inserted later (Vue/React/HTMX/Blazor/Electron), so frameworks only need to import it once. All behaviour is event delegation on document — no per-element setup, no cleanup.

config.how: Set window.ArmsysUIConfig = {...} before the script loads (read-only afterwards via ArmsysUI.config).

options.sheetBreakpoint: 640 — menus/modals become bottom sheets at or below

dataAttributes.data-aui-modal-close: Close the closest dialog (value from data-aui-value).
dataAttributes.data-aui-static: On a dialog: ignore Escape and backdrop clicks.
dataAttributes.data-aui-dropdown / data-aui-dropdown-tr: Dropdown wrapper and its toggle button.
dataAttributes.data-aui-sheet=\"false|true\": On [data-aui-dropdown]: control bottom-sheet presentation on phones.
dataAttributes.data-aui-keep-open: On a .aui-menu-item: keep the menu open after click.
dataAttributes.data-aui-popover=\"#id\": Toggle a floating .aui-popover anchored to the trigger.
dataAttributes.data-aui-tabs / data-aui-tab / data-aui-: Tabs with keyboard support; sync groups share and remember selection.
dataAttributes.data-aui-copy[=\"text|#target\"]: Copy text, a target element, or the nearest code block/input.
dataAttributes.data-aui-confirm=\"Title\" (+ -message,: Ask for confirmation before the click proceeds (works on links, submit buttons, menu items).
dataAttributes.data-aui-nav-toggle[=\"#target\"]: Toggle .is-open on the site header (default) or an off-canvas sidebar/docs nav (adds backdrop + scroll-lock).
dataAttributes.data-aui-sidebar-collapse: Toggle .aui-app--collapsed (icon rail). Remembered when the .aui-app has data-aui-collapsible.
dataAttributes.data-aui-choice + data-aui-choice-group: Single-choice buttons that show/hide [data-aui-when] blocks (billing period, step views).
dataAttributes.data-aui-select (on <select>): Enhanced searchable combobox (data-aui-search, data-placeholder, multiple, option[data-description]).
dataAttributes.data-aui-autosize / data-aui-counter / d: Textarea autosize, character counter, password strength meter.
dataAttributes.data-aui-range-value: Live value output next to input.aui-range.
dataAttributes.th[data-aui-sort] / data-aui-select-all: Client-side table sort and row selection with bulk bar.
dataAttributes.data-aui-toc: Scroll-spy for any nav of #anchor links.
dataAttributes.data-aui-command / data-aui-command-open: Command palette dialog and its triggers (+ mod+k).
dataAttributes.data-aui-lines / data-aui-hl / data-aui-: Line numbers, highlighted, added and removed lines.

api.openModal(ref, {returnFocus}) / closeMod: Open/close dialogs with animation, scroll-lock and focus return.
api.confirm(opts) → Promise<boolean>: { title, message, confirmText, cancelText, variant, icon }
api.prompt(opts) → Promise<string|null>: { title, label, value, placeholder, type, required, confirmText }
api.toast(opts) → element: { title, message, variant, icon, action:{label,onClick}, position, timeout, loading } — returns el with .update(opts)
api.toast.promise(promise, { loading, succes: Loading toast that resolves to success/danger.
api.position(anchor|{x,y}, el, placement, of: Flip/shift positioning helper for custom floating UI.
api.refreshSelect(select): Rebuild an enhanced select after changing options.
api.addTag(el, value): Add a tag to a [data-aui-tags] input.

icons: Use <svg class="aui-icon"><use href="#aui-i-NAME"/></svg>. Names: see ArmsysUI.icons or ai/icons.json.
